decisions.ramMaximumRationale: Keep the £300 ceiling regardless of market inflation.
decisions.ssdPolicyRationale: Keep £230 target / £300 maximum. SN5100 is a value choice, not permission to raise the target to its observed price.
decisions.researchScope: No further broad Performance review unless implementation exposes a genuine problem.

pricingPolicy.dateOnlyEvidence: Use 00:00 UTC on observedOn as a conservative lower bound; never invent a check time.
pricingPolicy.comparison: Delivered price, only when both delivery amounts are known. Item-price ceilings apply before delivery.

ryzen9600x.name: Ryzen 5 9600X
ryzen9600x.why: Six Zen 5 cores and a modern AM5 platform; no extra cores bought for their own sake.
ryzen9600x.compatibility: AM5; 65W rated TDP; retail CPU has no cooler. Use stock power settings.

msib850.name: B850 GAMING PLUS WIFI
msib850.why: Integrated Wi-Fi, useful expansion and the right connections for the build.
msib850.compatibility: ATX 304.8 × 243.8mm. Two-DIMM slots per manual; SSD in M.2_1; GPU in top x16 slot. Do not confuse MAX, PZ, WIFI6E or B850M variants.

pa120se.name: Peerless Assassin 120 SE — non-RGB
pa120se.why: Straightforward air cooling without liquid-cooling cost or complexity.
pa120se.compatibility: AM5 supported. 155mm nominal height versus 163mm case allowance; keep fan mounting within this limit. Four-pin PWM fans.

gigabyte9070.name: Radeon RX 9070 GAMING OC 16G
gigabyte9070.why: 16GB RX 9070 performance with an independently assessed cooler and conventional power connectors.
gigabyte9070.compatibility: 288 × 132 × 50mm; 77mm nominal length margin in H6 Flow. Two separate PSU PCIe 6+2 cables; 750W PSU recommendation.

pulse9070.name: PULSE Radeon RX 9070 16GB
pulse9070.why: A compact, quiet RX 9070 option when a qualifying offer makes it the better purchase.
pulse9070.compatibility: 280 × 120.25 × 51.5mm; 85mm nominal length margin. Two separate PCIe 6+2 cables; 650W PSU recommendation.

fitv28.name: FIT V black 32GB (2×16GB) DDR5-6000 CL28
fitv28.why: Low-profile EXPO memory. Chosen for the available value, not because this build needs CL28.
fitv28.compatibility: 33.21mm high; two DDR5 UDIMMs; AMD EXPO. 6000MT/s is an overclocked profile; exact-system stability is not yet tested.

vulcan38.name: T-Force Vulcanα black 32GB (2×16GB) DDR5-6000 CL38
vulcan38.why: Low-profile EXPO alternative; looser timings are acceptable when it offers better value.
vulcan38.compatibility: 32.7mm high; 1.25V rated profile; AMD EXPO; lifetime warranty. Exact MSI QVL membership and physical stability are not claimed.

sn5100.name: WD Blue SN5100 2TB
sn5100.why: A sensible gaming drive with room for a substantial library; flagship storage is not required.
sn5100.compatibility: Bare M.2 2280 PCIe 4.0 x4; QLC NAND; 900TBW and five-year limited warranty. Large writes can slow after cache exhaustion. Use M.2_1 and its board heatsink.

sn7100.name: WD_BLACK SN7100 2TB
sn7100.why: Approved TLC alternative when price and stock justify switching.
sn7100.compatibility: Bare M.2 2280 PCIe 4.0 x4; TLC; 1,200TBW and five-year limited warranty for 2TB. Use M.2_1 and the board heatsink.

rm750x.name: RM750x (2024) ATX 3.1 — UK
rm750x.why: Fixed, high-quality power supply keeps modular-cable instructions consistent.
rm750x.compatibility: 750W; 160 × 150 × 86mm; Type 4 modular cables; two EPS and two separate PCIe 6+2 leads. Use only supplied cables. Native 12V-2x6 cable is unused. Ten-year warranty.

h6flow.name: H6 Flow black — original non-RGB
h6flow.why: A clear dual-chamber layout and three supplied intake fans; no speculative extra fan.
h6flow.compatibility: GPU length allowance 365mm, cooler height 163mm, PSU length 200mm. Three included 120mm intake fans.

asus9070xtprimeoc.name: Prime Radeon RX 9070 XT OC 16GB
asus9070xtprimeoc.why: 16GB graphics for high-quality 1440p and capable 4K gaming with game-appropriate settings.
asus9070xtprimeoc.compatibility: 312 × 130 × 50mm; 53mm nominal length margin in H6 Flow. Use PCI_E2 and three separate supplied RM850x PCIe 6+2 leads, one per GPU socket. Cable clearance and GPU support need physical verification.

msib850mwifi6e.name: B850M GAMING PLUS WIFI6E
msib850mwifi6e.why: Micro-ATX AM5 board with Wi-Fi 6E, 2.5Gb Ethernet and two M.2 slots; useful gaming features without unnecessary expansion cost.
msib850mwifi6e.compatibility: Micro-ATX 243.84 × 243.84mm. Match standoffs to the board; no unused standoff beneath the PCB. GPU in PCI_E2 (not the small PCI_E1); SSD in M2_1; RAM in A2/B2. Verify the exact 9600X minimum BIOS and shipped version. Regional numeric SKU/EAN remains unverified; do not substitute another MSI variant.

rm850x2024uk.name: RM850x (2024) ATX 3.1 — UK
rm850x2024uk.why: 850W headroom at stock settings and a documented three-lead GPU cable plan.
rm850x2024uk.compatibility: 160mm PSU in a 200mm nominal allowance. Use three separate supplied Type 4 PCIe 6+2 leads for this GPU; confirm exact UK box contents. EPS/CPU cables are different. Never reuse modular cables from another PSU. Native 12V-2x6 GPU cable is unused.

reaper9070xt.name: Reaper Radeon RX 9070 XT 16GB
reaper9070xt.why: 16GB graphics for 1440p gaming, with settings chosen for each game.
reaper9070xt.compatibility: 289mm body / 304mm including bracket; fits the H6 Flow 365mm length allowance. Install in PCI_E2. Use two separate supplied RM850x PCIe 6+2-pin leads, one per socket. Do not use EPS cables or the unused 12V-2x6 lead.

sn7100_1tb.name: Black SN7100 1TB
sn7100_1tb.why: 1TB of fast storage to get started; add storage later if your library needs it.
sn7100_1tb.compatibility: Bare M.2 2280 PCIe 4.0 NVMe drive. Install in M2_1, secure the retention and remove the board heatsink thermal-pad film before refitting it.

freezer36standard.name: Freezer 36 — standard silver fins / black fans
freezer36standard.why: Air cooling suited to the stock-power Ryzen 5, without liquid-cooling complexity.
freezer36standard.compatibility: 159mm tall against the H6 Flow 163mm limit. Use the supplied AM5 mounting kit and paste; retain the AM5 backplate. Remove the cold-plate protective film. Connect the two PWM fans via their PST connection to CPU_FAN1. Follow the Arctic manual for mounting orientation and tightening.

parts.notes: 1080p-focused 8GB card. Reduce texture quality in games that exceed its memory; do not assume maximum settings. Fit in PCI_E1 and connect one PSU PCIe 6+2-pin plug. The card uses eight PCIe lanes and runs at PCIe 4.0 on this platform. Palit specifies 262.1 × 126.3 × 40.1mm, below the 365mm case length limit, and a 550W recommended PSU; this build uses 650W.

parts.name: MSI B550M PRO-VDH WIFI
parts.notes: Exact B550M PRO-VDH WIFI, not the CEC variant. Install RAM in DIMMA2/DIMMB2 and the SSD in M2_1. Match micro-ATX standoffs. parts.name: Corsair Vengeance LPX 16GB (2x8GB) DDR4-3200 CL16
parts.notes: Two 8GB DDR4 modules in A2/B2. Start at default memory settings, then try A-XMP 3200 only after a stable first boot. This DDR4 kit cannot be reused on an AM5 DDR5 board.

parts.name: Kingston NV3 1TB M.2 2280
parts.notes: Bare 1TB M.2 2280 PCIe NVMe SSD. Secure in M2_1 using the board retention and heatsink; remove the thermal-pad protective film. Capacity can be expanded later if needed.

parts.notes: Included with the boxed CPU; do not buy a second cooler. Remove the AM4 plastic retention brackets but retain the backplate. Follow AMD’s screw-mounted cooler instructions and tighten evenly. Use the pre-applied paste once; do not add more on top. Connect its fan to CPU_FAN1.
